2608.24048.title: Don't Just Listen, Try Planning: Graph-based Retrieval-Generation Agent for Long-form Audio Meeting Understanding
2608.24048.paper_summary: While long-form audio meeting understanding (LAMU) is garnering growing attention, task-specific question answering (QA) datasets remain scarce. Existing speech QA paradigms and state-of-the-art Speech LLMs suffer from acoustic information loss and poor long-term context memory. To address these issues, we construct the LongAudioQA dataset and propose the GRGA model, which models heterogeneous audio features into a multi-dimensional graph and leverages agent planning for retrieval and answer generation.
2608.24048.paper_summary_zh: 雖然長格式音頻會議理解（LAMU）正受到越來越多的關注，但特定任務的問題回答（QA）數據集仍然稀缺。現有的語音QA範式和最先進的語音LLM在聲學信息損失和長期上下文記憶方面存在不足。為了解決這些問題，我們構建了LongAudioQA數據集並提出了GRGA模型，該模型將異質音頻特徵建模為多維圖並利用代理規劃進行檢索和答案生成。
